title: Boys Tracing Workbook Printable, Truck Construction Alphabet Tracing PDF, Preschool Kids Activity, GoodNotes iPad, Instant Download
description:
🚛 The boys-themed tracing workbook that trucks-obsessed preschoolers actually want to use — real letters, numbers, and shapes to trace, dressed up in dump trucks, diggers, and traffic cones.

Meet the Kawaii Interactive Tracing Workbook (Truck Zone) — the construction/vehicle-themed sibling of our original tracing workbook, built for boys ages 3-7 who'd rather trace a Tow Truck than an apple. 71 pages of real dashed-outline letter, number, shape, and sight-word tracing extracted from an actual font's letterforms, not a simplified approximation. Every trace is followed by real ruled space to write it independently.
